% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): two marked plots with a legend,
% scale only axis, and embedded TikZ using axis coordinates.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  scale only axis,
  width=6cm, height=4cm,
  legend pos=north west,
]
\addplot+[mark=*] coordinates {(1,2) (2,3) (3,2.5) (4,4)};
\addlegendentry{first}
\addplot+[mark=square*, dashed] coordinates {(1,1) (2,1.5) (3,3) (4,3.2)};
\addlegendentry{second}
\draw[red, thick] (axis cs:1.5,1) -- (axis cs:3.5,3.5);
\node[draw, fill=yellow, anchor=south] at (axis cs:2.5,3.6) {peak};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
